execution: All training, preprocessing, historical/API scoring, inference and size auditing ran on dislab. Local actions were source edits, Git, file transfer, hashing and browser/display checks.
data_lineage: Original H13 historical-only counts cache transferred readonly; context/time feature hashes verified before fitting. Historical counts SHA256 recorded at fit-start. No independent raw-trip rebuild in H22.

failures.detail: First staging copy attempted while SCP still held the input file. Training did not start. Waited for completed transfer, copied input and ran the same published plan.

First harness failed importing run from large_run because the helper lacked the package folder in sys.path. The actual CLI/HTTP checks before that import worked. Fixed helper path only; rerun passed14. No model or numerical code change.

Initial v1 README had repository-relative links that do not resolve after extraction. v1.0.1 changes document links to commit-specific repository URLs and includes final results. Weights and inference code unchanged; earlier asset hashes preserved.

limitations: Original September API repeatedly exposed, not independent unseen test.
Historical completed counts do not measure latent lost demand or February/March stock.
Historical warm-start, training budget and conditioning topology differ from H13; not a pure causal width ablation.
No matched XGBoost comparison or traffic-feature training.
No actual dispatch outcome or causal service improvement.
Installed matching dislab environment tested; fresh virtual environment installation not tested.
No H18 collection restart or fresh API calls during H22 checks.
